card.name: Start of the word Concomitant
card.fires_on: The 'com' piece in the middle of 'Concomitant', right after 'Con', at the start of a sentence about concomitant use or administration in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Concomitant
modes.description: 'Con' + 'com' starting a sentence after a drug-interaction heading or enzyme inhibitor/inducer name.
modes.example: CYP3A4 Inhibitors Con<<com>>itant use of AKYNZEO with

modes.label: Lowercase concomitant
modes.example: Therefore, con<<com>>itant use of MAOIs with par

card.writes: It pushes toward word endings like 'nty' and 'alis' and away from '-ing' endings, so it favors completing the word as 'comitant' rather than 'com' + 'ing'.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of the word 'concomitant' when a drug interaction sentence begins, such as 'Concomitant use of...'.
